observation.visible_scene: A static industrial-lab view: a translucent rectangular block (wrapped in plastic film, with a small dark fitting on its right face) rests on a metal table. To its right stands a black cylinder marked with yellow diagonal hazard stripes, mounted on a circular metal base, with a chrome piston rod rising above it. The background is a green wall bearing three yellow lightning-bolt warning signs. The camera and the block/cylinder positions remain fixed throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: Frames 1-9 are a static interval with no visible change in the block or cylinder.
At frame 10 a faint blue wisp appears at the right edge of the block near the cylinder base, marking the onset of blue material entering the scene.
From frames 11-13 a blue jet streams leftward from the right-side fitting into the block, and a blue blob forms and grows just inside the right face, with a thin stem connecting it to the fitting.
Frames 14-16 show the internal blue mass splitting into two rounded lobes side by side.
Frames 17-23 the internal blue mass re-coalesces into a single larger rounded blob with a rightward stem; the top-right surface of the block appears to dome slightly upward.

From frame 24 onward the internal blue blob develops a leftward protrusion and continues to morph (lobes and a small left bud growing then receding), while a separate blue stream also extrudes from the right fitting, runs down the side, and spreads as a growing puddle on the metal base beside the cylinder through frame 41.
The blue material inside the block changes shape and size in place (expansion/deformation) rather than translating across the block; the block itself does not move on the table.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause or mechanism of the blue injection (no operator, pump action, or piston motion is visible).
The pressure/flow conditions before frame 1 and the final outcome after frame 41.
Whether the chrome rod or cylinder moved at all (their positions look constant, but the segment is too short to confirm any actuation).
uncertain_details: Whether the slight bulge at the block's top-right edge is genuine surface deformation or a viewing/reflection artifact.
Whether the blue mist around the cylinder in frames 10-12 is spray from the injection or a separate event.
The exact material identities of the transparent block and the blue substance (not determinable from appearance alone).
